title: The Legal right of the tenant
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：legal　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 legal 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the grower wrote of ① a legal right of the tenant in the ledger, and everybody in the greenhouse said at once that it was ② so legal that nobody in the greenhouse would go near it. Three summers on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the grower, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the legal ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the legal right of the tenant that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1983 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too legal to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the buyer who had come to help; the legal ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a legal paper for the court, and said that no buyer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as legal as the paper for the court they had once had in the old greenhouse. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was legal or not, and he said so.

By 1996 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something legal, and nothing besides. The buyer from the next greenhouse called the whole plan ⑧ quite legal; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the legal ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1999, in silence, she wrote of another legal right of the tenant in the same ledger, and the work, which took two summers, seemed ⑨ no less legal than anybody had expected. ⑩ The legal paper for the court that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2001, was the one she could never quite name; the legal ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 法律（前置定语 a legal right of the tenant：1989 年种植户在收成账里记下的那件法律的权利）
B. adj. 法律／合法（两处加强说法：so legal that … 与 no less legal than …）
C. adj. 法律／合法（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 法律（表语 too legal to do：母亲觉得它太法律，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 合法（前置定语 a legal paper for the court：叔叔把整件事称作一桩合法的文件）
F. adj. 合法（同级比较 as legal as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩呈给法庭的文件相比）
G. adj. 合法（后置定语 something legal：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 合法（受程度副词修饰 quite legal：那位收购人的评价）

items.q: a legal right of the tenant
the legal right of the tenant that
a legal paper for the court
The legal paper for the court that

answers.why: legal 意为“法律”，1989 年种植户在收成账里记下的是“一件法律的权利”，此处作前置定语 a legal right of the tenant。
legal 意为“法律”，此处用 so legal that 结构，说它法律到大棚里没人敢靠近。
legal 意为“法律”，收成账上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的法律承租人合法的权利，等于最高级的说法。
legal 意为“法律”，母亲认为这件东西“太法律了，谁也用不上”，too legal to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
legal 意为“合法”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩合法的文件”，此处作前置定语 a legal paper for the court。
legal 意为“合法”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩呈给法庭的文件一样合法”，同级比较用 as legal as。
legal 意为“合法”，收成账上那半行字要的是“合法的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something legal。
legal 意为“合法”，邻大棚来的那位收购人认为这套计划“相当合法”，quite 修饰原级 legal。
legal 意为“合法”，no less legal than 表示“其合法不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之合法不亚于任何人的预料。
legal 意为“合法”，母亲 2001 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的合法文件”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1989 年，种植户在收成账里记下了一件法律的权利。（a legal right of the tenant）
它法律到大棚里没有一个人敢靠近。（so legal that …）
母亲觉得它太法律，谁也用不上。（too legal to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩合法的文件。（a legal paper for the court）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩呈给法庭的文件一样合法。（as legal as …）
到了 1996 年，收成账上只剩半行字：要的是一件合法的东西。（something legal）
answers: In 1989 the grower wrote of a legal right of the tenant in the ledger.
It was so legal that nobody in the greenhouse would go near it.
My mother thought it too legal to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a legal paper for the court.
He said nobody would call it as legal as the paper for the court they had once had.
By 1996 the ledger asked for nothing but something legal.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 legal 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the grower wrote of a legal right of the tenant in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the legal right of the tenant that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too legal to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a legal paper for the court, and nobody argued with him.
The buyer from the next greenhouse called the plan quite legal, and everybody laughed.
The legal ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
